openings.claim: Removable rim clips could carry sideways load through hatch-edge stops while applying only enough vertical retention to prevent escape, reducing dependence on seal friction.
openings.delta: Change the load carrier from increased corner pressure to lateral bearing. Make two opposed clip assemblies from paired supplied strips, bolts and padded jaws; locate their bolt shanks as hatch-edge stops only if actual rim access and hatch geometry permit. Remove the clips completely before inspection; tether them externally with the supplied cord.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, stronger corner clamping, lightly retained positive stops should resist the 20 N pull without requiring the pressure increase associated with opposite-corner lift. If lightly retained stops slip or allow hatch escape, or tightening is still necessary and produces rocking, this proposed separation of functions fails.
openings.probe: First measure accessible rim underside, edge clearances and stop directions with the ruler. Reject fabrication if two padded clip assemblies cannot capture the rim and constrain the supplied pull direction without touching or trapping the seal. If feasible within ninety minutes, use ten closure/pull trials for this configuration, reopening each cycle and timing one technician. Record position before and after each 20 N pull, corner lift and visible seal damage. Put the 1 mm card at the specified right contact for the tenth, final closure. Require all valued outcomes; stop upon damage. Reserve the two remaining trials for a tighter-clamp rival, including its own disturbed final closure, before the ten-cycle sequence. Those two trials discriminate sensitivity only, not rival durability.
assumptions: Rim underside is accessible and the supplied strips can span the required jaw geometry; these indispensable facts are unprovided.
Four bolts and four pads suffice for two clips, with no permanent deformation or new seal tears.
Clip removal, external cord routing and reinstalling permit an unobstructed opening, thirty-second reopening and ten trials within twenty minutes.
The supplied pull direction can be constrained by the chosen stop locations; stop compliance remains below 1 mm.

assessment: A fabrication-screened probe, not a deployment claim. Unknown rim geometry may defeat the operation before testing. A damage stop provides protection, not evidence of feasibility.
